summary: Both the righteous and the wicked in Jerusalem will be slain—Babylon will draw a sharp and bright sword against Israel and will prevail.
meta_description: Both the righteous and the wicked in Jerusalem will be slain—Babylon will draw a sharp and bright sword against Israel and will prevail.

footnotes.note27_b: The Hebrew word shiloh may be a short form of asher-lo, which can be rendered “whose right it is.”
footnotes.note29_a: IE While they see false visions for you.
